Python 3.11 or newer. The core install solves Table II with no
credentials and no downloads. `tidyfinance` is required only to rebuild
CRSP / Compustat from WRDS.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/tlorans/kiku-value-premium-replication.git
cd kiku-value-premium-replication
uv pip install -e .
```

```{python}
import sys
import tidyfinance as tf
import geap

sys.version_info[:2], geap.__version__
```

From a notebook, without a clone:

```bash
pip install "geap[fast] @ git+https://github.com/tlorans/kiku-value-premium-replication.git"
```

The analytical solution is instant:

```{python}
model = geap.LongRunRisksModel()
print(model.solve(method="analytical").summary())
```

The quadrature solution is the same two lines with the default method.
It takes a few seconds:

```{python}
res = model.solve()
print(res.summary())
```

The model prices the claims as a set. Name the two you want to compare:

```{python}
print(res.compare("value", "growth", market="market").summary())
```

No number on a documentation page is typed by hand. A model number is
printed by a cell on that page. A data number is attributed to Kiku
(2006).

## Extras

```bash
uv pip install -e ".[fast]"
uv pip install -e ".[data]"
```

`[fast]` installs Numba, which the Euler grid uses. `[data]` installs
matplotlib, pyarrow, polars, and plotnine, which the 1930 to 2003 panel
rebuild and the site plots need.

```{python}
import polars as pl
import plotnine as p9

pl.__version__, p9.__version__
```

## WRDS

Rebuilding CRSP / Compustat from scratch needs credentials. If you stay
with the shipped 1930 to 2003 CSVs, skip this section. Run once per
machine:

```python
tf.set_wrds_credentials()
```

The call writes a `.env` file that the downloader reads.
`geap.build_annual_panel(refresh=True)` then queries WRDS, and
`refresh=False` reuses `data/raw/*.parquet` or the shipped CSVs.

If credentials are missing, the call raises `EmpiricalDataError` with a
message telling you to call `tf.set_wrds_credentials()`.

Consumption and the deflator come from FRED:

```python
import geap

dc = geap.load_consumption()      # real per-capita ND+S growth, from NIPA
defl = geap.load_deflator()       # PCE implicit price deflator
```

The stock panel needs CRSP monthly returns with `retx`, Compustat book
equity merged through the CCM links, and the Davis–Fama–French
historical book-equity file for the years before Compustat's coverage
begins. `geap.build_annual_panel` runs the construction: the quintile
sort, the value weighting, the Campbell–Shiller recovery of the return
identity, deflation, and the real bill rate.

```python
annual = geap.campbell_shiller_annual(ret, retx, defl)
rf = geap.real_rf_from_monthly(t90ret, cpi)
```
